text: [Image #1] i cannot apply materials to anything but the front face this side face does not take them
resolution: Fixed the building material side-face bug in the workbench stage. The stage render used the opposite 90°/270° yaw convention from game/build raycastPieces, so clicking a turned side wall selected one face slot while the textured front/back slab was drawn on the other side. Extracted pure stage face math, aligned stageQuarterNormal with the build-system yaw frame, made Stage use the shared helper for slab placement and face picking, and added a regression pin proving yaw-90 side clicks target the same slot the render slab displays. Verified focused workbench/buildings suite 21/21 and full hmsc-int cart bundle. No commit made; working-tree fix only.
